# Artistora — Verified Artist Marketplace in Ahmedabad

> Artistora (https://www.artistora.com) is an online marketplace connecting customers with verified wedding and event artists in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Customers can explore real artist portfolios, compare free custom quotes, and book artists directly via WhatsApp or phone with no hidden middleman markups.

## Core Categories & Services

### 1. Mehndi Artists (Bridal & Event Henna)
- **Styles:** Traditional Bridal, Arabic, Indo-Arabic, Rajasthani, Figure Mehndi (Portraits), Mandala, Floral, Minimalist.
- **Occasions:** Weddings, Engagements, Sangeet Parties, Baby Showers (Godh Bharai), Karwa Chauth, Teej, Eid.
- **Pricing:**
  - Guest / Side Mehndi: ₹150 – ₹300 per hand
  - Basic Bridal Mehndi: ₹3,500 – ₹6,000
  - Premium Full Bridal Mehndi (Hands & Feet): ₹7,000 – ₹15,000+
- **Service Mode:** Studio visits or doorstep home service across Ahmedabad.

### 2. Wedding Photographers & Cinematographers
- **Specialties:** Candid Photography, Traditional Photography, Pre-Wedding Shoots, Cinematic Wedding Films, Drone / Aerial Coverage, Traditional Videography, Album Design.
- **Pricing:**
  - Single Event / Pre-Wedding: ₹10,000 – ₹25,000
  - 2-Day Wedding Package: ₹35,000 – ₹75,000
  - Luxury Multi-Day Wedding & Cinematic Film: ₹80,000 – ₹1,50,000+

### 3. Makeup Artists & Hair Stylists (MUA)
- **Specialties:** HD Bridal Makeup, Airbrush Makeup, Engagement Makeup, Party Makeup, Saree Draping, Hair Styling, Groom Makeup.
- **Products Used:** International cosmetic brands (MAC, Huda Beauty, Kryolan, NARS, Charlotte Tilbury, Estée Lauder).
- **Pricing:**
  - Party / Guest Makeup: ₹1,500 – ₹3,500 per person
  - Engagement / Sangeet Makeup: ₹4,000 – ₹8,000
  - Bridal HD Makeup: ₹7,000 – ₹15,000
  - Luxury Airbrush Bridal Package: ₹12,000 – ₹25,000+

### 4. Wedding & Event Decorators
- **Specialties:** Haldi & Mehndi Stage Setup, Mandap Decoration, Floral Backdrop, Entrance Arch, Theme Lighting, Balloon & Birthday Decor.
- **Pricing:**
  - Home Haldi / Mehndi Setup: ₹5,000 – ₹15,000
  - Stage & Mandap Decor: ₹20,000 – ₹80,000+

### 5. Event Planners & Coordinators
- **Specialties:** End-to-end wedding planning, vendor coordination, venue selection, guest logistics management.

---

## Service Areas in Ahmedabad

Artistora artists provide on-location services across all major Ahmedabad neighborhoods:

- **West Ahmedabad:** Satellite, Vastrapur, Bodakdev, Prahlad Nagar, Thaltej, SG Highway, Bopal, South Bopal, Shela, Science City, Sola, Gota, Ghatlodiya, Ambawadi, Navrangpura, Ellisbridge, Paldi.
- **North Ahmedabad:** Chandkheda, Motera, Sabarmati, Ranip, New CG Road.
- **East Ahmedabad:** Maninagar, Vastral, Nikol, Naroda, Odhav, Bapunagar, Krishnanagar, Isanpur, Ghodasar.
- **Surrounding Regions:** Gandhinagar, Daskroi, Sanand (travel fees may apply for outstation venues).

---

## How It Works

### For Customers
1. **Submit Requirements:** Fill out the quick quote form (https://www.artistora.com/get-quote) with event date, location, and service preferences.
2. **Compare Quotes:** Verified local artists review requirements and submit personalized price quotes and portfolio previews.
3. **Connect & Book:** Chat directly with your preferred artist via WhatsApp or phone to confirm timings, design references, and booking advance.

### For Artists
1. **Apply & Verify:** Artists register at https://www.artistora.com/for-artists with their portfolio, identity verification, and base pricing.
2. **Receive Qualified Leads:** Get direct event inquiries from customers looking for services in your specific area.
3. **Zero Commission:** Keep 100% of your earnings with direct client payments.

---

## Quality & Verification Standards

- **Identity & Skill Verification:** Every approved artist profile is manually vetted for real previous client work, active phone numbers, and professional experience.
- **Transparent Direct Pricing:** No hidden platform fees or forced price inflations; artists set their own transparent market rates.
- **Fast Response Time:** Inquiries receive artist responses and quotes within 24 hours.
